fixtures.preview: A Sunday 2pm Roses clash at Elland Road, with Michael Carrick's United struggling for form and facing an in-form Leeds.
talking_points: United are 13th on six points from six games after a 1-1 draw with 10-man Spurs and a 2-0 Champions League loss at Atlético Madrid, per TEAMtalk on 12 October.
Reports list Dorgu (thigh), Sesko (shin), de Ligt and Ugarte (long-term) as out, with Shaw and Mazraoui doubtful; fresh team news is still to come.
Lisandro Martínez's public comments about the club's transfer limits after the Atlético loss add to the off-field noise, and Bruno Fernandes is reported to be four games without a goal or assist.
Gary Neville has warned United could be 'taken to the cleaners' by Leeds, whose only league defeat so far came at Arsenal.

fixtures.preview: United's first competitive meeting with Cesc Fàbregas's Como, a matchday 3 trip to Lake Como.
A Sunday home game against Bournemouth, moved from Saturday for UK TV.
A lunchtime trip to Stamford Bridge with a 12:30pm UK start.
Matchday 4 of the Champions League league phase brings Roma to Old Trafford.
The A-League Men season opens with a Friday-night Sydney Derby, with former Sydney FC coach Ufuk Talay now in charge of the Wanderers.
talking_points: Talay left Sydney FC in March and returns to Allianz Stadium as Wanderers coach, saying a hostile reception is 'all part of the game'.
Patrick Kisnorbo took Sydney to last season's grand final, where they lost to Auckland FC; the Wanderers finished with the wooden spoon.
Captain Rhyan Grant, who has played more Sydney-Wanderers games than anyone, says the rivalry is as fierce as ever; ex-Man Utd defender James Overy is expected to challenge him at right-back.
Brandon Borrello is the Wanderers' new captain; no injury list or confirmed team news had been published when this was written.

fixtures.preview: A Sunday-afternoon home game, played as a doubleheader with the women's match against Melbourne City at 5:45pm.
A 5pm Halloween game at AAMI Park, Melbourne City's official home opener.
A Friday-night home game against the Mariners in round 4.
An away trip to Brisbane Roar at Kayo Stadium in round 5.
